05123a3ef5d9c940aacb2a69e98ed5fce1791439.summary: A 2016 Cisco Umbrella blog post on domain generation algorithms (DGAs) used by malware, with the Necurs family as the worked example. It explains that analysing DGA DNS sessions can surface other malicious infrastructure. It then traces a Facebook-message campaign that delivered a malicious browser extension through linked sites, and notes many 'pw' domains hosting JavaScript files. The report says the sites were blocked or sinkholed and describes the attackers in general terms.
